description: Chantiers de transport combinés is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Liste des chantiers de transport combinés du Réseau Ferré National. Les chantiers de transport combiné de SNCF Réseau sont des espaces exclusivement utilisés pour le transport rail/route, et qui permettent de charger ou décharger les UTI par grue mobile ou portique (pas de sites SNCF Réseau sur les ports). Coverage: France. The portal files it under Réseau. Its keywords are SNCF RESEAU, Chantiers transport combiné. The portal shows 2022-03-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
